title: Chronic Kidney Disease Risk Screening

serum_creatinine.label: Serum Creatinine
serum_creatinine.description: Primary biochemical marker of glomerular filtration rate.

blood_urea.label: Blood Urea Nitrogen
blood_urea.description: Waste product filtered by functional renal nephrons.

albumin.label: Urine Albumin (Proteinuria)
albumin.description: Presence of protein in urine indicating glomerular barrier permeability.

fasting_glucose.label: Fasting Blood Glucose
fasting_glucose.description: Glycemic measurement relevant to diabetic nephropathy risk.

hemoglobin.label: Hemoglobin
hemoglobin.description: Blood oxygen carrier; reduced in renal anemia.

history_hypertension.label: Hypertension History
history_hypertension.description: Documented prior diagnosis of high blood pressure.

history_diabetes.label: Diabetes History
history_diabetes.description: Documented prior diagnosis of diabetes mellitus.

pedal_edema.label: Pedal Edema (Fluid Retention)
pedal_edema.description: Swelling in feet or ankles due to fluid retention.

dataset.name: HealthAI Chronic Kidney Disease Cohort Benchmark

limitations: This model provides statistical screening risk estimates, not definitive diagnostic nephrology determinations.
Estimates should be confirmed through clinical laboratory panels (eGFR, comprehensive urinalysis) under physician supervision.
Transient fluctuations in hydration status or acute illness can temporarily alter creatinine and blood urea readings.
